description: Stop an audience enrollment run. A queued run is cancelled immediately; a running run stops after the batch it is currently enrolling. Contacts already enrolled stay in the sequence (use cancel_sequence_enrollments to remove them).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

runId.description: Audience enrollment run ID to cancel.

name: cancel_sequence_audience_enrollment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `cancel_sequence_audience_enrollment` MCP tool.

audienceEnrollment.description: The run after cancellation: status cancelled, or running with cancelRequestedAt while it stops.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
